# Retention Data Note

Captured via MCP ingest on 2025-02-10.

The voluntary turnover rate for Q4 2024 was 6.1%, down from 8.9% in Q3 2024.
The improvement was attributed to the introduction of flexible working arrangements
and a 5% pay increase for roles below the market median.

High-risk retention segments: engineering (12.3%), sales (10.7%).
Low-risk retention segments: finance (3.2%), legal (2.8%).

Source: mcp://note-retention-q4-2024
